layers.layer_name: US Census County And Equivalent Entity
layers.description: County and equivalent entity boundaries from the U.S. Census TIGER/Line national shapefile record layout (2025). Attribute definitions are derived from Figure 75 (Appendix I-2) of the TIGER/Line Technical Documentation.

columns.name: countyns
columns.description: ANSI feature code for the county or equivalent feature (8-character string).

columns.name: geoid
columns.description: County identifier; concatenation of current state FIPS and county FIPS codes (5-character string).

columns.name: geoidfq
columns.description: Current fully qualified GEOID used to join data tables from data.census.gov (14-character string).

columns.name: namelsad
columns.description: Current county name and translated LSAD code (up to 100 characters).

columns.name: classfp
columns.description: Current FIPS class code (2-character string). See ANSI code lists for class definitions: https://www.census.gov/library/reference/codelists/ansi.html#cou

columns.name: funcstat
columns.description: Current functional status code (1-character string). See ANSI code lists for definitions: https://www.census.gov/library/reference/codelists/ansi.html#cou

columns.name: aland
columns.description: Current land area value as provided by TIGER/Line (numeric field length 14).

columns.name: awater
columns.description: Current water area value as provided by TIGER/Line (numeric field length 14).

columns.name: intptlat
columns.description: Current latitude of the internal point (11-character string).

columns.name: intptlon
columns.description: Current longitude of the internal point (12-character string).
